description: Users are unable to log into the application. Database connection pool has reached maximum limit. Application logs show repeated timeout errors.
symptoms: Login failures, slow response times, timeout errors in app logs
root_cause_notes: Connection pool size was not increased after recent traffic spike. Max connections set to 100, actual demand reached 340.
resolution_notes: Increased connection pool size to 500. Restarted application servers to clear stale connections.
work_notes: Checked DB metrics at 08:45. Confirmed pool exhaustion. Escalated to DBA team at 09:00. Temporary fix applied at 10:30.
close_notes: Permanent fix scheduled - connection pool auto-scaling to be implemented in next sprint.
